execution.checks: independent scalar residual-value score ranking + heap first-index replay for every step; integer feasible/volume/bin/trajectory checks; prefix match; selector outcomes equal chosen actual branch; all risk invariance
execution.failure: Preserve complete or partial raw trajectory on caught exceptions, including soft CPU limit580. Stop on any failure, no numerical retries or dropping cases. Abrupt OS hard kill/OOM cannot guarantee in-memory partial trajectory persistence; completed files and outer logs remain.
execution.host: 5000 empty C100 slots, all feasible bins including unused, ascending index first argmax; fixed score sources byte-identical
execution.online_interface: one-pass iterator; selector invoked after exactly500 calls before item501 fetched; only prefix/state/model arguments; no metadata, seed, distribution label or future statistics available
execution.training_freeze: MODEL.json written and hashed before opening confirmation/risk raw outcomes

family_sampling: Same six pre-existing stress families; fresh disjoint SHA256 seed blocks train and confirmation; clipped continuous values then ties-even integer rounding

features.histograms: 10 equal integer size buckets 1..10 ...91..100; used residual buckets0..9 ...90..99; frequencies normalize by prefix length or number used bins
features.inputs: Only first 500 arrived integer items and exact 500-item BF residual state in fixed 5000 slots
features.normalization: training mean and population std only; zero std becomes 1
features.order: adjacent strict increase and decrease fractions; last100 minus first100 mean, /100

grouping: All three orderings of one multiset stay in same split; confirmation inference clusters all three. Family/order balanced synthetic finite mixture; no deployment-population claim.

no prompt or parent selection changes
no old benchmark results used as labels
